transport.stdout: one JSON object per line; no non-JSON output
transport.failure: nonzero exit plus a final {"ok":false,"error":{"code":...,"message":...}} object

commands.run: accepts --snapshot and --result; executors advertising task-profile-v1 also accept optional --mode review|profile and --task-profile-receipt for same-revision review context; writes a structured result and emits the same result

commands.doctor: verifies native CLI identity, authentication, isolation prerequisites, and skill-load observability
commands.version: returns exact adapter, CLI, model, tool-policy, limits, and sandbox identity
commands.prepare: accepts --trial; creates only trial-local projection files and returns the sealed execution
commands.run: accepts --trial, --prepared, and --output; executes the exact prepared native command
commands.normalize: accepts --raw and --trace; emits the common trace vocabulary with digest linkage
commands.collect: accepts --trial and --artifacts; exports only task-declared workspace artifacts

commands.remove: removes only registrations owned by this adapter
